item.title: PAGASA Daily Weather - 4:00 PM, 24 August 2026
item.description: At 3:00 PM today, the center of the eye of Typhoon "OBET" {SAUDEL} was estimated based on all available data at 1,375 km East Northeast of Extreme Northern Luzon (24.5°N, 134.6°E) with maximum sustained winds of 165 km/h near the center and gustiness of up to 205 km/h. It is moving West Northwestward at 30 km/h. Southwest Monsoon affecting Luzon.
